name: Windsurf
detailed: Windsurf is an AI-powered coding IDE developed by Codeium, designed to keep developers in flow state. It features Cascade, an advanced AI assistant with memory capabilities that remembers important aspects of your codebase and workflow. Key features include automatic lint error detection and fixing, MCP (Model Context Protocol) support for connecting custom tools like Figma, Slack, Stripe, and PostgreSQL, drag-and-drop image-to-code conversion, natural language terminal commands, and Turbo mode for auto-executing terminal commands. Windsurf is trusted by over 1 million users and 4,000+ enterprise customers, with AI reportedly writing 94% of code. The platform supports Sequential Thinking, plugin management, and integrates with popular development workflows to enhance productivity across teams.

name: Same
detailed: Same is a collaborative design and prototyping platform that enables design teams to create, share, and iterate on product designs in real-time. The tool combines design capabilities similar to Figma or Sketch with built-in collaboration features, version control, and developer handoff workflows. Same emphasizes synchronous collaboration, allowing multiple designers to work on the same project simultaneously with live cursors, comments, and instant updates. The platform supports vector design, prototyping, design systems, component libraries, and design tokens for consistent UI development. Use cases include product design for web and mobile apps, marketing materials, and design system management. Same integrates with development tools, offering export capabilities for CSS, React components, and design specifications. The platform offers various pricing tiers, with team collaboration, unlimited projects, and advanced features available in paid plans. Same targets product design teams, UX/UI designers, and organizations seeking efficient design-to-development workflows with strong collaboration and version control features.

name: Vibecode
detailed: Vibecode is an AI-powered mobile app builder that enables users to create native iOS and Android applications without traditional coding. The platform uses artificial intelligence to interpret natural language descriptions of app features, generate user interfaces, implement functionality, and produce deployable mobile apps. Users describe their app concept, target features, and design preferences, and Vibecode's AI constructs the application structure, screens, navigation flows, and business logic. The tool supports common app patterns like user authentication, data management, push notifications, payments, and API integrations. Vibecode offers both free and paid tiers, with premium plans providing advanced features, custom branding, app store publishing assistance, and export of source code. The no-code/low-code platform targets entrepreneurs, startups, small businesses, and non-technical founders who want to test app ideas quickly without hiring developers. Vibecode emphasizes speed, accessibility, and reducing barriers to mobile app creation. While AI-generated apps may require developer refinement for complex features, Vibecode accelerates the initial build phase and helps validate concepts before investing in custom development.

name: PostSyncer
detailed: PostSyncer is a social media scheduling platform designed to simplify multi-platform content distribution for creators, marketers, and businesses. The tool allows users to compose content once and schedule it across multiple social networks including Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram, and others. Key features include a unified scheduling calendar, automatic timezone conversion, post queuing, analytics tracking, and bulk upload capabilities. PostSyncer offers both free and paid plans, with premium tiers providing advanced scheduling options, team collaboration features, and detailed performance analytics. The platform aims to streamline social media management workflows, reduce repetitive posting tasks, and help users maintain consistent online presence across platforms. PostSyncer is particularly useful for small businesses, solopreneurs, and marketing teams who manage multiple social accounts and need efficient content distribution without the complexity of enterprise-grade tools.

name: Pimlico
detailed: Pimlico is a smart account infrastructure platform for Web3 applications, providing developers with tools to implement account abstraction (ERC-4337) and create seamless user experiences in decentralized applications. The platform offers APIs, SDKs, and infrastructure for gasless transactions, social logins, session keys, account recovery, and batch transaction processing. Pimlico enables Web3 apps to provide user experiences comparable to traditional applications by abstracting away blockchain complexities like gas fees, seed phrases, and transaction signing. Developers can integrate Pimlico to offer features like sponsored transactions (apps pay gas fees), email/social login for wallet creation, automated transaction bundling, and smart contract wallet management. The platform supports Ethereum and EVM-compatible chains, targeting dApps, wallets, games, and consumer-facing Web3 applications seeking mainstream adoption. Pimlico emphasizes developer experience, reliable infrastructure, and reducing onboarding friction for non-crypto-native users. The service operates on various pricing models depending on usage and feature requirements. Pimlico is part of the broader account abstraction ecosystem aiming to make Web3 more accessible and user-friendly.

name: Beam AI
description: Platform for agentic automation and AI agents
detailed: Beam AI is a comprehensive platform for building, deploying, and managing agentic AI systems and autonomous agents that can perform complex tasks with minimal human intervention. The platform provides infrastructure, tools, and frameworks for creating AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool use, and multi-step workflows. Beam AI supports integration with large language models (LLMs), external APIs, databases, and automation tools, enabling developers to build agents that can interact with software systems, process information, and execute actions autonomously. Use cases include customer support automation, data processing pipelines, research assistants, code generation agents, and business process automation. Beam AI offers both free and paid tiers, with enterprise features including advanced orchestration, scalability, monitoring, and compliance tools. The platform targets developers, enterprises, and AI researchers building production-grade agent systems. Beam AI emphasizes reliability, observability, and governance, providing logging, debugging, and safety mechanisms to ensure agents operate within defined boundaries and deliver consistent results.

name: Substack
detailed: Substack is a platform for creating, distributing, and monetizing paid email newsletters and publications. The service allows writers, journalists, and content creators to build direct relationships with audiences through subscription-based newsletters. Substack provides tools for writing posts, sending emails, managing subscribers, processing payments, and building communities around content. Writers can offer free newsletters, paid subscriptions, or hybrid models with both free and premium content tiers. The platform handles payment processing, subscriber management, and email delivery infrastructure. Substack takes a 10% fee on paid subscriptions plus payment processing fees, with writers keeping the majority of revenue. Key features include customizable publication design, analytics, community discussions, podcast hosting, and mobile apps. Substack has become popular among independent journalists, thought leaders, niche experts, and creators seeking sustainable monetization outside traditional media or advertising-dependent models. The platform emphasizes writer independence, direct audience relationships, and sustainable creator economics. Substack serves writers building media businesses, monetizing expertise, and establishing authority in specific domains through consistent, high-quality content.

name: Dia Browser
description: AI chat with your browser tabs
detailed: Dia Browser is an AI-enhanced web browser that allows users to chat with and extract information from their open browser tabs using conversational AI. The tool integrates directly into the browsing experience, enabling users to ask questions about content across multiple tabs, summarize articles, compare information, extract data, and perform research tasks without manually switching between tabs and copying information. Dia Browser uses natural language processing to understand queries and retrieve relevant information from active browser sessions, creating a more efficient research and browsing workflow. The platform offers both free and paid tiers, with premium features including unlimited queries, advanced AI models, tab management automation, and data export capabilities. Use cases include academic research, competitive analysis, content aggregation, comparison shopping, and any task requiring synthesis of information from multiple web sources. Dia Browser targets students, researchers, journalists, analysts, and knowledge workers who spend significant time gathering and processing web-based information. The tool represents the evolution of browsers toward AI-native interfaces that understand and assist with user intent beyond simple navigation.

name: LM Studio
description: Local LLM runner and model manager
detailed: LM Studio is a desktop application for running large language models (LLMs) locally on personal computers without requiring cloud services or subscriptions. The free tool allows users to download, manage, and interact with open-source language models including GPT-style models, Llama variants, Mistral, and other openly available LLMs. LM Studio provides a user-friendly interface for model discovery, downloading models from Hugging Face, configuring inference parameters, and chatting with models privately on local hardware. The application supports GPU acceleration (NVIDIA, AMD, Apple Silicon), quantization for efficient memory usage, and local API servers compatible with OpenAI's API format. Use cases include privacy-sensitive applications, offline AI access, experimentation with different models, and development without API costs. LM Studio is popular among developers, researchers, and privacy-conscious users who want full control over their AI infrastructure. The tool runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, with hardware requirements depending on model size. LM Studio represents the growing ecosystem of local-first AI tools, enabling powerful language model interactions without dependency on cloud providers.

name: Haiku Trade
detailed: Haiku Trade is a decentralized finance (DeFi) trading platform focused on providing efficient, low-cost trading of digital assets across multiple blockchain networks. The free platform offers decentralized exchange (DEX) functionality with features like limit orders, market orders, cross-chain swaps, and liquidity aggregation to find optimal trading prices. Haiku Trade integrates with major DEX protocols and liquidity sources to route trades through the most efficient paths, minimizing slippage and fees. The platform supports EVM-compatible chains like Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Polygon, allowing users to trade tokens without centralized intermediaries. Key features include non-custodial trading (users retain control of funds), MEV protection, advanced trading charts, portfolio tracking, and integration with popular Web3 wallets like MetaMask and WalletConnect. Haiku Trade targets DeFi traders, yield farmers, and crypto investors seeking decentralized alternatives to centralized exchanges with better privacy, security, and control. The platform emphasizes user experience, making DeFi trading accessible to both beginners and experienced traders through intuitive interfaces and smart routing algorithms.

name: Surveillance Watch
detailed: Surveillance Watch is a comprehensive database and tracking platform documenting surveillance technologies, companies, government programs, and privacy-impacting systems worldwide. The free resource aggregates information about facial recognition systems, location tracking technologies, data brokers, government surveillance programs, and privacy-invasive tools deployed by corporations and states. Users can browse by entity type (companies, government agencies, technologies), filter by surveillance method (biometric, location, communication intercept), and explore relationships between surveillance actors. The platform serves privacy advocates, journalists, researchers, policymakers, and citizens concerned about privacy rights and surveillance expansion. Surveillance Watch provides transparency about who is collecting data, what technologies are being deployed, where surveillance systems operate, and how information flows between entities. The database emphasizes accountability, informed consent, and public awareness of surveillance infrastructure often hidden from public view. Surveillance Watch functions as a research tool, advocacy resource, and educational platform highlighting the scale and scope of modern surveillance ecosystems. The platform aims to empower individuals and communities to understand and resist intrusive surveillance practices.

name: Soniox
detailed: Soniox is an enterprise-grade speech-to-text API platform that provides highly accurate audio transcription services powered by advanced AI models. The platform specializes in converting spoken language into text across multiple languages, accents, and audio quality conditions. Soniox offers low-latency streaming transcription for real-time applications, batch processing for recorded audio, speaker diarization (identifying who said what), custom vocabulary adaptation for domain-specific terminology, and punctuation/formatting capabilities. The paid service targets developers, enterprises, call centers, media companies, and applications requiring reliable voice recognition including voice assistants, meeting transcription tools, podcast transcription, customer service analytics, and accessibility features. Soniox emphasizes accuracy, speed, and API reliability with 99.9% uptime SLAs. The platform supports REST APIs, WebSocket streaming, and SDKs for Python, JavaScript, and other languages. Pricing is typically usage-based with volume discounts, making it suitable for both startups and large-scale enterprise deployments requiring high-volume transcription capabilities with predictable performance.

name: Gamma
description: AI presentation maker and website builder
detailed: Gamma is an AI-powered presentation and website builder that enables users to create professional presentations, documents, and web pages through natural language prompts and AI-assisted design. Unlike traditional slide-based tools, Gamma generates fully formatted, visually appealing content with intelligent layouts, images, and styling based on user input. Users describe their topic, provide key points, and Gamma constructs complete presentations with appropriate structure, transitions, and visual hierarchy. The platform supports collaborative editing, templates, media embedding, analytics, and export to PDF or web formats. Gamma also functions as a website builder, creating landing pages and documentation sites with the same AI-driven approach. The tool offers free and paid tiers, with premium features including unlimited presentations, custom branding, advanced analytics, and team workspaces. Gamma targets educators, business professionals, marketers, and anyone needing to communicate ideas visually without design expertise. The platform emphasizes speed and quality, transforming rough ideas into polished presentations in minutes. Gamma aims to democratize professional communication design through AI assistance.

name: God of Prompt
description: 30000+ AI prompts for ChatGPT Claude Gemini Midjourney
detailed: God of Prompt is a comprehensive library of over 30,000 AI prompts optimized for popular language models and image generation tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Midjourney. The paid resource provides pre-crafted prompts across categories including writing, marketing, business, programming, design, education, entertainment, and specialized professional use cases. Each prompt includes instructions, examples, and customization tips to help users achieve better results from AI tools. God of Prompt aims to solve the challenge of prompt engineering by offering tested, effective prompts that produce high-quality outputs consistently. The platform targets content creators, marketers, developers, business professionals, and AI enthusiasts who want to maximize productivity with AI tools without mastering prompt engineering. The resource is particularly valuable for Midjourney users seeking specific image styles, compositions, and artistic effects. God of Prompt includes regular updates with new prompts, community contributions, and prompt templates for emerging AI tools. The platform positions itself as a comprehensive prompt engineering resource, helping users unlock the full potential of AI tools through expertly crafted instructions.

name: LNVPN
description: Disposable phone numbers for SMS verification
detailed: LNVPN is a privacy-focused service providing disposable phone numbers for SMS verification without requiring personal phone numbers or long-term subscriptions. The paid platform allows users to receive SMS messages to temporary phone numbers from various countries, useful for verifying accounts on websites, apps, and services that require phone-based authentication. LNVPN helps protect privacy by preventing services from collecting users' real phone numbers, reducing spam, and maintaining anonymity. The service supports verification for social media accounts, messaging apps, online services, cryptocurrency exchanges, and other platforms requiring SMS confirmation. Users select a country and phone number, use it for verification, and receive the SMS code through LNVPN's web interface. The platform is particularly popular among privacy-conscious users, travelers needing local numbers for temporary use, developers testing SMS-based features, and individuals managing multiple online identities. LNVPN operates on a pay-per-use or credit-based model, making it cost-effective for occasional needs without monthly subscriptions. The service emphasizes privacy, no registration requirements, and instant number availability.

name: Maestro
description: End-to-end UI testing for mobile and web
detailed: Maestro is an end-to-end UI testing framework for mobile and web applications, offering a single unified platform for testing iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Web apps, and more. Maestro Studio provides a free visual testing IDE that empowers developers, testers, and non-technical users to create maintainable tests without deep coding knowledge. Key features include visual element inspection, action recording, AI-assisted test generation via MaestroGPT, and cross-platform compatibility. Users can run tests locally with the free CLI or scale with Maestro Cloud, which integrates into CI/CD pipelines for pre-release, nightly, and pull request testing. The platform supports Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, NativeScript, .NET MAUI, Capacitor, Cordova, mobile browser testing, and web views. Maestro Studio is available for Mac, Windows, and Linux, enabling shift-left testing practices to catch issues early in development.

name: OpenTimestamps
detailed: OpenTimestamps is an open-source, decentralized timestamping proof standard that uses the Bitcoin blockchain to create cryptographic proofs that data existed at a specific point in time. The protocol defines a flexible set of operations for creating provable timestamps and independently verifying them later without relying on trusted third parties. OpenTimestamps operates through free calendar servers that aggregate timestamp requests and anchor them to the Bitcoin blockchain, eliminating the need for users to pay individual transaction fees. The system is permissionless, requires no registration or API keys, and ensures verifiable, tamper-proof records. Use cases include intellectual property protection, document authentication, audit trails, and legal evidence. The standard is flexible enough to support various timestamping methods beyond Bitcoin, making it a foundational tool for decentralized proof-of-existence applications in legal, academic, and business contexts.

name: Designverse
description: Create any app at light speed with AI
detailed: Designverse AI is an AI-powered application builder that enables users to create functional apps at high speed through natural language descriptions and AI-generated designs. The platform uses artificial intelligence to transform app concepts into complete application designs, including UI layouts, navigation flows, feature implementations, and even code generation. Users describe their app idea, target audience, and desired features, and Designverse produces working prototypes with professional designs and core functionality. The tool supports web apps, mobile apps, and hybrid experiences, offering both free and paid plans with varying levels of customization and export options. Designverse emphasizes speed, design quality, and reducing the gap between concept and prototype. The platform targets entrepreneurs, startups, designers, and non-technical founders who need to validate ideas quickly, create investor demos, or build MVPs without extensive development resources. While AI-generated apps may require developer refinement for production deployment, Designverse significantly accelerates the initial design and prototyping phases, making app creation more accessible and cost-effective.

name: FINE TUNING
detailed: FINE TUNING is a technology services company specializing in quantum-optimized solutions for computing, simulation, and advanced scientific applications. The company focuses on bridging classical computing with quantum technologies, offering consulting, development, and implementation services for quantum algorithms, quantum-inspired optimization, and hybrid classical-quantum systems. FINE TUNING serves research institutions, technology companies, pharmaceutical firms, financial services, and organizations exploring quantum computing for solving complex computational problems like molecular simulation, portfolio optimization, logistics planning, and cryptography. Services may include quantum algorithm development, performance optimization of quantum circuits, feasibility studies for quantum applications, and training for teams transitioning to quantum-aware development practices. The company positions itself at the cutting edge of quantum technology, helping clients prepare for and leverage quantum computing advancements. FINE TUNING emphasizes practical applications of quantum technologies, focusing on delivering measurable value and performance improvements through quantum-optimized approaches. The company targets forward-thinking organizations investing in next-generation computing capabilities.

name: Origon AI
detailed: Origon AI is a comprehensive agentic operating system designed for building, deploying, and observing AI agent systems with enterprise-grade reliability. The platform consists of three main components: Studio (drag-and-drop agent design interface), Sessions (real-time observation and debugging), and Insights (unified dashboard for performance metrics). Origon runs on dedicated infrastructure engineered for sub-second performance and includes an integrated knowledge engine that connects agents directly to organizational knowledge bases for accurate, context-aware responses. The platform comes pre-configured with hundreds of MCP connectors, APIs, and communication channels including voice, chat, WhatsApp, Slack, and custom code execution capabilities. Built for developers and engineered for architects, Origon emphasizes speed, reliability, security, and end-to-end governance across the entire AI lifecycle.

name: AI 2027
description: AI future prediction and scenario planning
detailed: AI 2027 is a research and scenario planning platform focused on predicting and exploring potential futures of artificial intelligence and its societal impact by the year 2027. The free resource aggregates expert forecasts, trend analysis, scenario modeling, and speculative timelines for AI capability development, regulatory changes, economic disruptions, and technological breakthroughs. The platform presents multiple future scenarios ranging from optimistic (widespread beneficial AI deployment) to cautionary (misalignment, job displacement, regulation failures) to help policymakers, researchers, businesses, and the public prepare for various outcomes. AI 2027 includes visualizations, research papers, expert interviews, and community discussions about near-term AI development trajectories. Use cases include strategic planning for AI adoption, risk assessment, investment decisions, policy formulation, and public discourse. The platform targets AI researchers, technology executives, policymakers, investors, and informed citizens interested in AI's short-term trajectory. AI 2027 emphasizes thoughtful consideration of AI's transformative potential and risks, encouraging proactive planning and responsible development. The platform serves as both an educational resource and a conversation starter about humanity's AI future.

name: HeyGen
detailed: HeyGen is an AI-powered video creation platform that generates spokesperson videos with AI avatars and voices, enabling users to create professional video content without filming, actors, or expensive production. The platform offers a library of realistic AI avatars (diverse ages, ethnicities, styles) that can deliver scripts with natural lip-sync, gestures, and expressions. Users input text scripts, select avatars and voices, customize backgrounds and branding, and HeyGen generates the video automatically. The tool supports multiple languages, voice cloning (create custom avatar voices), green screen effects, and video templates for various use cases including marketing videos, training content, product demonstrations, personalized messages, and social media content. HeyGen offers free and paid tiers, with premium plans providing more credits, custom avatars, higher resolution, and commercial usage rights. The platform targets marketers, content creators, educators, HR teams, and businesses needing video content at scale without the cost and complexity of traditional video production. HeyGen emphasizes accessibility, speed, and quality, making professional video creation available to non-video professionals.

name: Play Hub
detailed: Play Hub is an on-chain automation network for cryptocurrency traders, offering tools for copy trading, arbitrage detection, and predictive analytics across DeFi protocols. The platform enables users to automate trading strategies, mirror successful traders' portfolios, identify arbitrage opportunities across DEXs, and leverage predictive models for market movements. Play Hub supports multiple blockchain networks including Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, and other EVM-compatible chains. Key features include automated execution of trades, risk management parameters, strategy backtesting, and real-time alerts for arbitrage opportunities. The platform caters to both novice traders who want to copy experienced traders' strategies and advanced users seeking automation for complex trading logic. Play Hub operates through smart contracts, ensuring transparent, trustless execution of strategies. Pricing and revenue models may include subscription fees, performance fees, or token-based governance. The platform targets crypto traders seeking to improve returns through automation, diversification, and data-driven strategies without constant manual monitoring. Play Hub aims to democratize sophisticated trading strategies through accessible automation and social trading features.

name: Bloom
detailed: Bloom is an AI-powered productivity tool designed to enhance personal and professional workflows through intelligent task management, note-taking, and knowledge organization. The platform uses artificial intelligence to automatically categorize notes, suggest related content, generate summaries, and surface relevant information when needed. Bloom integrates with calendars, email, project management tools, and communication platforms to create a unified workspace for knowledge workers. Key features include smart search, AI-generated meeting notes, task prioritization, context-aware reminders, and collaborative workspaces. The tool is aimed at professionals, students, researchers, and teams who handle large volumes of information and need efficient systems for capturing, organizing, and retrieving knowledge. Bloom offers both free and paid tiers, with premium features including unlimited storage, advanced AI capabilities, team collaboration, and integrations with enterprise tools. The platform emphasizes reducing cognitive load, preventing information overload, and helping users stay focused on high-value work.

name: Rive
description: Interactive animation and motion design tool
detailed: Rive is a powerful interactive animation and motion design tool that enables designers and developers to create real-time, state-based animations for games, apps, websites, and products. Unlike traditional animation software, Rive focuses on interactive graphics that respond to user input, game logic, or application state changes. The platform provides a visual editor where designers can create vector graphics, define animations, set up state machines, and build complex interactive behaviors without coding. Rive animations are lightweight, runtime-driven, and exportable to multiple platforms including iOS, Android, Web, Unity, Unreal, and Flutter. Use cases include character animations for games, micro-interactions for UI/UX, animated illustrations, loading screens, and interactive data visualizations. Rive offers both free and paid plans, with collaboration features, version control, and advanced state machine capabilities in premium tiers. The tool bridges the gap between design and development, allowing designers to deliver polished, responsive animations directly to production.

name: Nomads.com
detailed: Nomads.com is a platform and community for digital nomads providing resources, tools, and connections for location-independent professionals and remote workers. The platform offers city guides, cost-of-living data, visa information, co-working space directories, accommodation recommendations, and community forums where nomads share experiences and advice. Nomads.com helps users find suitable destinations based on criteria like internet speed, cost of living, climate, time zones, and community vibes. The platform includes both free resources and paid membership tiers with premium features like detailed guides, exclusive events, job boards, and networking opportunities. Use cases include trip planning, finding remote work-friendly locations, connecting with other nomads, accessing local discounts, and navigating visa/legal requirements for extended stays abroad. Nomads.com targets freelancers, remote employees, entrepreneurs, and anyone pursuing location-independent lifestyles. The platform emphasizes community, practical information, and sustainable travel practices. Nomads.com serves as both an informational resource and a social network for the growing digital nomad movement seeking to live and work from anywhere.

name: Hugging Face Spaces
description: Discover ML apps made by the community
detailed: Hugging Face Spaces is a free platform for discovering, using, and deploying machine learning applications and demos created by the AI community. Hosted on Hugging Face's infrastructure, Spaces allows developers and researchers to share interactive ML demos built with frameworks like Gradio and Streamlit. Users can explore thousands of applications covering image generation, text analysis, audio processing, computer vision, natural language processing, and more—all runnable directly in the browser without local setup. Spaces serves as both a showcase for ML capabilities and a tool for rapid prototyping and experimentation. Developers can deploy their own models, create interactive interfaces, and share them with the community or embed them in websites. The platform supports GPU acceleration for compute-intensive models and integrates with Hugging Face's model hub, datasets, and ecosystem. Spaces targets AI researchers demonstrating work, developers building ML tools, educators teaching AI concepts, and anyone wanting to experiment with state-of-the-art models without technical barriers. Hugging Face Spaces democratizes access to ML applications, making cutting-edge AI accessible to broader audiences.

name: Cap
detailed: Cap is a screen recording platform designed for creating beautiful, shareable screen recordings with automatic enhancements and easy distribution. The tool captures screen activity, webcam footage, and audio while automatically applying polish like smooth animations, clean layouts, and branded elements. Cap emphasizes creating recordings that look professional without manual editing, making it ideal for product demos, tutorials, bug reports, sales presentations, and internal communication. The platform offers both free and paid tiers, with premium features including unlimited recordings, custom branding, advanced analytics on view counts and engagement, and integrations with tools like Slack, Notion, and project management software. Cap provides instant shareable links after recording, enabling quick distribution without file management or upload delays. name: Everifin
detailed: Everifin is a Slovak-based financial services platform that provides multibanking, e-invoicing, and digital wallet solutions. Built on the EU's PSD2 (Payment Service Directive 2) open banking framework, Everifin aggregates multiple bank accounts from different institutions into a single mobile app, guaranteeing at least 90% coverage of banks in each supported country. The platform's e-invoicing feature allows businesses and individuals to issue, receive, and pay invoices digitally and ecologically. The digital wallet enables instant payments directly from bank accounts without physical cards, supporting in-store contactless transactions. Everifin leverages secure, licensed third-party access to financial data, ensuring compliance with EU regulations while providing innovative fintech products. The platform is designed for consumers and businesses seeking centralized financial management, simplified invoicing workflows, and modern payment methods across Slovakia and potentially other European markets.

name: Monospace ASCII Generator
detailed: Monospace ASCII Generator is a web-based tool for creating ASCII art and text-based graphics using monospace fonts. The free tool, hosted on CodePen, allows users to convert images or text into ASCII representations using characters like letters, numbers, and symbols arranged to form pictures or stylized text. ASCII art is useful for terminal displays, code comments, text-based interfaces, retro aesthetics, or situations where graphical images cannot be used. The generator provides options for character density, contrast adjustment, and output size. Users can upload images or type text and receive ASCII versions suitable for copying into code, documents, or terminal applications. The tool is popular among developers, designers creating retro projects, and artists exploring text-based creative mediums. Monospace ASCII art has nostalgic appeal and practical applications in command-line tools, documentation, and minimalist design. The generator demonstrates creative uses of simple web technologies and serves as both a utility and an artistic tool for text-based visual creation.

name: Rain
detailed: Rain is a fintech platform building stablecoin-powered payment cards and infrastructure for everyday transactions. The company enables users to spend USDC and other stablecoins directly through Visa or Mastercard-branded debit cards, converting crypto to fiat at the point of sale. Rain's infrastructure supports real-time settlement, low fees, and global acceptance at millions of merchants. The platform targets crypto holders who want to use their digital assets for daily purchases without manually converting to fiat or paying high exchange fees. Rain emphasizes compliance, working within regulatory frameworks to offer licensed payment services. Additional features include mobile app management, spending controls, rewards programs, and integration with DeFi protocols for yield-generating balances. Rain's mission is to bridge the gap between cryptocurrency and traditional commerce, making stablecoins a practical medium of exchange for rent, groceries, travel, and online shopping. The platform serves individuals, businesses, and developers seeking stablecoin payment solutions.

name: Superheat
detailed: Superheat is a technology company focused on redefining residential and commercial energy infrastructure through smart hardware, software, and decentralized energy systems. The platform aims to make energy generation, storage, and distribution more efficient, affordable, and sustainable by integrating solar power, battery storage, smart thermostats, and energy management software. Superheat's solutions target homeowners, property developers, and businesses seeking to reduce energy costs, improve resilience against outages, and transition to renewable energy sources. The company emphasizes innovation in heat pump technology, thermal energy storage, and demand-side management to optimize energy consumption patterns. Superheat's business model combines hardware sales, software subscriptions, and energy services, positioning itself at the intersection of cleantech, IoT, and distributed energy resources. The platform addresses grid instability, rising energy prices, and climate concerns by empowering consumers to generate, store, and manage their own energy locally.

name: Duon Labs Voyons
detailed: Duon Labs Voyons is an assumption-free market simulation and analytical platform designed for financial modeling, scenario analysis, and predictive analytics without relying on traditional assumptions or historical bias. Unlike conventional financial models that depend on historical data, regression analysis, and predefined assumptions, Voyons uses advanced computational methods, agent-based modeling, and simulation techniques to explore market behaviors under various conditions. The platform is aimed at quantitative analysts, hedge funds, risk managers, and financial institutions seeking to model complex market dynamics, test trading strategies, and evaluate portfolio risks in volatile or unprecedented market conditions. Voyons allows users to define custom scenarios, simulate interactions between market participants, and observe emergent behaviors without assuming normal distributions or historical correlations. This assumption-free approach is particularly valuable for tail risk analysis, crisis scenario planning, and understanding non-linear market phenomena. The platform supports custom modeling languages, integration with data feeds, and collaborative research environments for quantitative teams.

name: Vals AI
detailed: Vals AI is an AI benchmarking and evaluation platform that provides comprehensive testing, comparison, and performance metrics for various artificial intelligence models across different tasks and domains. The platform allows developers, researchers, and organizations to assess AI model capabilities in areas like reasoning, coding, mathematics, language understanding, instruction following, and task-specific performance. Vals AI runs standardized benchmark suites, custom evaluation scenarios, and real-world task simulations to measure model accuracy, speed, reliability, and cost-efficiency. The platform supports comparison across models from different providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-source models) to help users select optimal models for specific applications. Use cases include model selection for production systems, research validation, competitive analysis, and tracking AI capability progression over time. Vals AI emphasizes transparency, reproducibility, and practical relevance of benchmarks beyond academic metrics. The platform targets AI engineers, product teams integrating AI, researchers, and organizations making strategic decisions about AI adoption and investment. Vals AI helps demystify AI performance through data-driven, comparative evaluations.

name: Loki.Build
description: AI website builder for high-quality landing pages
detailed: Loki.Build is an AI-powered website builder focused on creating high-quality, conversion-optimized landing pages quickly and efficiently.
